parsed.use_case: A log search service may need the shortest contiguous segment of an event stream that contains all required event types, including repeated types, to isolate a complete incident trace. The same need arises when extracting the smallest span of text containing every required token.
system_examples: Log aggregation and observability systems — isolate a compact trace or log excerpt containing all required event types.
Text search and document processing systems — extract the shortest passage containing a set of required terms with specified multiplicities.
parsed.explanation: A sliding window with character counts expands until it covers the required multiplicities, then contracts while coverage remains valid; this takes O(|s| + |t|) time and O(Σ) space for the character set. A naive scan of all substrings takes O(|s|²) candidates and can spend additional time checking each one, so the linear approach makes large text streams practical. This is a useful general pattern, though the exact task is more common as a text-processing primitive than as a named production feature.
